en: Black‑and‑white winter street scene in a small town. Wooden houses line both sides of a snow-covered road. An early 20th‑century automobile stands on the left side, and a few pedestrians walk in the distance. A telegraph pole is visible along the street. Printed text at the top left reads "Parti från Arjeploug". The overall style resembles an old photographic postcard.
